title: Bou's First Run

nodes.speaker: Bou Friday
nodes.text: Hey! Hi! Howdy, welcome to Coffee PoccoCup, what can I get you today?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey! Hi! Howdy, welcome to Coffee PoccoCup, what can I get you today?

nodes.speaker: Bou Friday
nodes.text: Coffee, right: you want it long, short, tall, multistory, grav-float, underpunched, blast foamed? Help me out here!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Coffee, right: you want it long, short, tall, multistory, grav-float, underpunched, blast foamed? Help me out here!

nodes.speaker: Bou Friday
nodes.text: Really? Can’t remember the last time someone asked me for… you’re sure? No bio-lumo syrups? No dry bean ice blasts?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Really? Can’t remember the last time someone asked me for… you’re sure? No bio-lumo syrups? No dry bean ice blasts?

nodes.speaker: Bou Friday
nodes.text: Ha! There are nine hundred and twelve customizations on our menu. In any combination. That’s like way too many possible drinks. And lemme tell you, no one wants “just coffee”.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ha! There are nine hundred and twelve customizations on our menu. In any combination. That’s like way too many possible drinks. And lemme tell you, no one wants “just coffee”.

nodes.speaker: Bou Friday
nodes.text: You got it, one cup of plain old joe coming right up.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You got it, one cup of plain old joe coming right up.

nodes.speaker: Bou Friday
nodes.text: We’re a dispatch hub. Coffee delivered to your fingertips. In... in theory that is.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We’re a dispatch hub. Coffee delivered to your fingertips. In... in theory that is.

nodes.speaker: Bou Friday
nodes.text: Right, sure. Gotta get those beans in. Here you are. Have a good day.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Right, sure. Gotta get those beans in. Here you are. Have a good day.

nodes.speaker: Bou Friday
nodes.text: Wait, what? No, really? Really? Yes! I just need someone to do a delivery run, four coffees, real simple...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Wait, what? No, really? Really? Yes! I just need someone to do a delivery run, four coffees, real simple...

nodes.speaker: Bou Friday
nodes.text: I’ll give you the drinks and send the customers’ locations to your HUD.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I’ll give you the drinks and send the customers’ locations to your HUD.

nodes.speaker: Bou Friday
nodes.text: Ok, we got one extra hot algae infusion, one strawberry gateaux choc bomb with toffee whip and scotch bonnet float, one white lithium grease latte, and an octo-shot espresso.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ok, we got one extra hot algae infusion, one strawberry gateaux choc bomb with toffee whip and scotch bonnet float, one white lithium grease latte, and an octo-shot espresso.

nodes.speaker: Bou Friday
nodes.text: Barely. Customers who want these have to sign a waiver.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Barely. Customers who want these have to sign a waiver.

nodes.speaker: Bou Friday
nodes.text: Thanks, feel free to keep any tips and… whatever people say, just don’t take it personally, OK?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thanks, feel free to keep any tips and… whatever people say, just don’t take it personally, OK?

nodes.speaker: Bou Friday
nodes.text: Morton, our delivery droid, has gone AWOL and I don’t know how I’m gonna get these orders out and my daily sales targets are already WAY down…

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Morton, our delivery droid, has gone AWOL and I don’t know how I’m gonna get these orders out and my daily sales targets are already WAY down…

nodes.speaker: Bou Friday
nodes.text: Just hand them over and I swear, I will give you free coffees for LIFE. Or, well, a couple of days at least.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Just hand them over and I swear, I will give you free coffees for LIFE. Or, well, a couple of days at least.
One coffee please.
You sound kinda stressed.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Just… a coffee. Caffeinated brown stuff.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Just… a coffee. Caffeinated brown stuff.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Just… a coffee. Caffeinated brown stuff.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Just… a coffee. Caffeinated brown stuff.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What is that?
Then call me "Nobody".

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: If you're so busy, where are all your customers?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If you're so busy, where are all your customers?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: If you're so busy, where are all your customers?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: If you're so busy, where are all your customers?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That’s too bad. Can I just get my coffee?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That’s too bad. Can I just get my coffee?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: That’s too bad. Can I just get my coffee?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: That’s too bad. Can I just get my coffee?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Can I help?
What do I do?
Sounds easy enough.
Octo-shot… is that legal?
I'm on it!
Leave these to me.
Keep it simple, please.
Well, I do.
What happened?
And in practice?
Have you got a list?
